patch_list: Suppresses indiscriminate startup requests for camera and storage permissions, and configures manifest for direct system camera capture.
Hides the gift / donation button in the top action bar of the main menu.
Disables all AdMob preloading, bypasses interstitial ads, and auto-removes the watermark on receipt screens without user interaction.
